sources.title: Neural Plasticity-Inspired Foundation Model for Observing the Earth ...
sources.snippet: DOFA mirrors the dynamic learning of the human brain for continuous model improvement from diverse data sources, making it highly adaptable for remote sensing's broad data spectrum. The experimental results showcase DOFA's versatility and effectiveness and confirm DOFA as a novel foundation model for analyzing complex remote sensing data.
